Usage: vlc [options] [stream] ...
Audio options:
      --audio, --no-audio         Toggle audio output
      --volume <integer [0 .. 512]>  Set volume
      --audio-language <string>  Choose an audio language
Playback options:
  -f, --fullscreen               Use full screen
      --rate <float>             Set playback rate
      --repeat, --no-repeat      Toggle repeat
      --sout <string>            Configure output
